verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Supabase Auth supports password, magic link, OTP, social login, and SSO out of the box (supabase-docs-6), with SDK-based quickstart setup (supabase-docs-19) and RLS policies to secure data tied to auth.uid() (supabase-docs-15). This directly matches email/password plus social OAuth via the platform SDK. missing for 10: no hands-on/community walkthrough timing the 'minutes' claim, and no explicit code sample showing the OAuth sign-in SDK call itself.
